title: [3/8/2024] Number of people employed in five types of work

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The bar chart illustrates the number of workers in five different occupations in an Australian region in 2001 and 2008.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, while most sectors experienced relatively minor changes in employment figures over the seven-year period, there was a notable increase in Computing jobs and a significant decline in Farming positions. In addition, Sales remained the dominant sector throughout the period, with substantially higher numbers than all other occupations.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Looking at the two largest employment sectors, Sales had approximately 150,000 workers in 2001, which was more than double the figure for Accounting at around 65,000. By 2008, while the number of people working in Sales saw a slight increase of about 10,000, the Accounting sector experienced a minor decline of roughly 5,000 workers.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the remaining occupations, Computing and Nursing employed similar numbers of around 55,000 people in 2001. While the Computing sector grew considerably to about 75,000 workers by 2008, the Nursing sector showed only a modest rise of approximately 5,000. Finally, Farming, which had the lowest employment figure of about 25,000 in 2001, saw this number decrease by roughly 10,000 by the end of the period.
